<div class="wrap">
<h1>Cash <span>profitability</span></h1>
<p class="sub">Sloan accruals and cash conversion from the earnings-quality tape. Click any column to sort ascending or descending. A name with no Sloan tag stays blank.</p>
<div id="kpis"></div>
<input id="q" aria-label="Filter ticker or company" placeholder="filter ticker">
<div id="board" role="region" aria-label="Reported cash profitability rows" tabindex="0">Loading earnings-quality…</div>
<details><summary>Complete received earnings-quality packet</summary><pre id="original" tabindex="0">Unavailable</pre></details>
<div class="foot">
<b>Built for:</b> seeing whether reported earnings are turning into cash.<br>
<b>Data:</b> /data/earnings-quality.json (reported Sloan accruals % assets, cash conversion, DSRI, FCF).<br>
<b>Definitions:</b> Sloan = (NI − OCF) / assets; cash conversion = OCF / NI. The table displays producer-tagged values only. Period alignment and underlying filing evidence remain unverified. Blank is missing, not zero.<br>
<b>Sort:</b> header click toggles asc/desc. Nulls sort last.
</div>
</div>
<script src="/jh-table-values.js"></script>
<script>
(async function(){
  function esc(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];});}
  function n(v,d){return JHTableValues.format(v,d==null?2:d);}
  function cmp(a,b,k,dir){
    return JHTableValues.compare(a,b,k,dir,k==="ticker"?"text":"number");
  }
  var received;
  try{received=await JHTableValues.load("/data/earnings-quality.json");}catch(e){if(typeof e.original_text==='string')document.getElementById('original').textContent=e.original_text;document.getElementById("board").textContent=e.message;return;}
  document.getElementById("original").textContent=received.raw;
  var d=received.packet,source=d.all_ranked||d.top_20_high_quality||[];
  if(!Array.isArray(source)){document.getElementById("board").textContent="Published population is malformed; inspect the original packet.";return;}
  var malformed=source.filter(function(x){return !x||typeof x!=="object"||Array.isArray(x);}).length;
  var rows=source.filter(function(x){return x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x);}).map(function(x){return {ticker:x.ticker,name:x.name,sloan:x.sloan_accruals_pct_assets,cash_conv:x.cash_conversion_ratio,dsri:x.dsri_beneish,quality_score:x.quality_score};});
  var SORT="sloan", DIR=1;
  document.getElementById("kpis").textContent=rows.length+" received rows; "+malformed+" malformed rows retained in the original packet. Producer publication "+(d.as_of||"unavailable")+". Source-period freshness is unverified.";
  var cols=[["ticker","Ticker","l"],["sloan","Sloan % assets",""],["cash_conv","Cash conv",""],["dsri","DSRI",""],["quality_score","Quality score",""]];
  function paint(){
    var q=(document.getElementById("q").value||"").toUpperCase();
    var view=rows.filter(function(r){return !q||(r.ticker+" "+(r.name||"")).toUpperCase().indexOf(q)>=0;});
    view.sort(function(a,b){return cmp(a,b,SORT,DIR);});
    var h="<table><thead><tr>";
    cols.forEach(function(c){h+="<th class='"+(c[2]||"")+(SORT===c[0]?" on":"")+"' data-k="+c[0]+">"+c[1]+(SORT===c[0]?(DIR>0?" ↑":" ↓"):"")+"</th>";});
    h+="</tr></thead><tbody>";
    view.forEach(function(r){
      h+='<tr><td class="l"><a class="tk" href="/ticker.html?symbol='+encodeURIComponent(r.ticker)+'">'+esc(r.ticker)+"</a></td>";
      h+='<td class="'+JHTableValues.sign(r.sloan,"neg","pos")+'">'+n(r.sloan,1)+"</td>";
      h+="<td>"+n(r.cash_conv,2)+"</td><td>"+n(r.dsri,2)+"</td><td>"+n(r.quality_score,1)+"</td></tr>";
    });
    document.getElementById("board").innerHTML=h+"</tbody></table>";
    JHTableValues.bindSort(document.querySelectorAll("#board th[data-k]"),SORT,DIR,function(k){if(SORT===k)DIR=-DIR;else{SORT=k;DIR=1;}paint();});
  }
  document.getElementById("q").addEventListener("input",paint);
  paint();
})();
</script>
<script src="/sidebar.js" defer></script>
</body></html>
